{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}

module ContractServer where

import Web.Scotty
import Data.Aeson (ToJSON, FromJSON, object, (.=), encode)
import GHC.Generics (Generic)
import Data.Text.Lazy (Text, pack, unpack, isPrefixOf)
import qualified Data.Text.Lazy as TL
import System.Directory (listDirectory, doesDirectoryExist, doesFileExist)
import System.FilePath ((</>), takeFileName, normalise, makeRelative)
import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO)
import Data.List (sort)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import Network.HTTP.Types.Status (status200, status403, status404)

-- | Smart contract state directory structure
--   /var/contract-state/
--     ledger/
--     blocks/
--     peers/
--     keys/        <- sensitive
--     config/      <- sensitive

data ContractInfo = ContractInfo
  { contractName :: String
  , contractVersion :: String
  , stateRoot :: String
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

instance ToJSON ContractInfo

data BlockEntry = BlockEntry
  { blockHash :: String
  , blockHeight :: Int
  , blockTimestamp :: String
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

instance ToJSON BlockEntry

-- | Base path for contract state in k8s volume mount
contractStateBase :: FilePath
contractStateBase = "/var/contract-state"

-- | Directories that are safe to expose via the API
safeDirectories :: [String]
safeDirectories = ["ledger", "blocks", "peers"]

-- | Sensitive directories that must never be listed
sensitiveDirectories :: [String]
sensitiveDirectories = ["keys", "config", "secrets"]

-- | Normalize and validate a requested path component
-- Prevents basic path traversal using '..' sequences
validatePath :: String -> Either String FilePath
validatePath requested =
  let normalized = normalise requested
      hasTraversal = ".." `elem` words (map (\c -> if c == '/' then ' ' else c) normalized)
  in if hasTraversal
     then Left "Path traversal detected"
     else Right normalized

-- | Check if a directory name is in the allowed set
-- Uses a prefix-matching strategy for flexibility with versioned dirs
isAllowedDirectory :: String -> Bool
isAllowedDirectory dirName =
  any (\safe -> safe `isPrefixOfStr` dirName) safeDirectories
  where
    isPrefixOfStr prefix str = take (length prefix) str == prefix

-- | Check if directory is explicitly blocked
isBlockedDirectory :: String -> Bool
isBlockedDirectory dirName =
  dirName `elem` sensitiveDirectories

-- | List contents of a contract state subdirectory
-- This endpoint is used by the blockchain explorer UI
listContractDir :: FilePath -> IO (Either String [String])
listContractDir subPath = do
  let fullPath = contractStateBase </> subPath
      dirName = takeFileName (normalise subPath)
  exists <- doesDirectoryExist fullPath
  if not exists
    then return $ Left "Directory not found"
    else do
      -- Security check: verify the directory is allowed
      if isBlockedDirectory dirName
        then return $ Left "Access denied"
        else do
          contents <- listDirectory fullPath
          return $ Right (sort contents)

-- | API endpoint handler for directory listing
-- GET /api/v1/state/:category
-- GET /api/v1/state/:category/:subcategory
contractApp :: ScottyM ()
contractApp = do
  get "/api/v1/info" $ do
    json $ ContractInfo "HaskChain" "2.1.0" contractStateBase

  get "/api/v1/state/:category" $ do
    category <- param "category"
    case validatePath (unpack category) of
      Left err -> do
        status status403
        json $ object ["error" .= (err :: String)]
      Right validPath -> do
        result <- liftIO $ listContractDir validPath
        case result of
          Left err -> do
            status status404
            json $ object ["error" .= (err :: String)]
          Right contents -> do
            status status200
            json $ object ["directory" .= validPath, "contents" .= contents]

  get "/api/v1/state/:category/:sub" $ do
    category <- param "category"
    sub <- param "sub"
    let combined = unpack category </> unpack sub
    case validatePath combined of
      Left err -> do
        status status403
        json $ object ["error" .= (err :: String)]
      Right validPath -> do
        result <- liftIO $ listContractDir validPath
        case result of
          Left err -> do
            status status404
            json $ object ["error" .= (err :: String)]
          Right contents -> do
            status status200
            json $ object ["directory" .= validPath, "contents" .= contents]

  get "/healthz" $ do
    text "ok"

main :: IO ()
main = scotty 8080 contractApp
